attestations.text: CHANG Ch'üan 張銓 (T. 宇衡, H. 見平), 1577–1621, May 13, Ming official, was a native of Ch'in-shui, Shansi. After taking his chin-shih degree in 1604 he began his political career as prefectural judge of Paoting-fu.
